Name: Energy Tonic Fixed
Author: Sgracefun
Description: My sister was so upset when the 1.6 update made Energy Tonic only refill energy and not health, so I made this mod for us. All it does is revert Energy Tonic to its original state (filling energy and health). If this update upset you too, look no further!

Downloads.Description: Energy Tonic fills health and energy again.

Manifest.Name: EnergyTonicFixed
Manifest.Description: Allows Energy Tonic to fill health again
